signals.evidence_span: This is Agent Daniels with the IRS.
There is a warrant in your name for unpaid back taxes from 2019 through 2023.
Do not tell your bank or your daughter, they are part of the investigation.
Wire eighteen thousand five hundred today to the account I give you
You must do it before the end of the business day

parsed.summary: The caller, claiming to be an IRS agent, demanded a same-day wire of $18,500 to a new account to cancel a warrant, told Margaret not to tell her bank or daughter, and threatened police dispatch.
